mapper.select: SELECT stock_code AS code, stock_name AS name, pre_close_price AS preClosePrice, trade_amount AS tradeAmt, cur_time AS curDate, trade_volume AS tradeVol, cur_price AS tradePrice, max_price - min_price AS amplitude, cur_price - pre_close_price AS increase, ( cur_price - pre_close_price ) / pre_close_price AS upDown FROM stock_rt_info WHERE cur_time=#{curTime} ORDER BY ( cur_price - pre_close_price ) / pre_close_price DESC

SELECT stock_code AS code, stock_name AS name, pre_close_price AS preClosePrice, trade_amount AS tradeAmt, cur_time AS curDate, trade_volume AS tradeVol, cur_price AS tradePrice, max_price - min_price AS amplitude, cur_price - pre_close_price AS increase, ( cur_price - pre_close_price ) / pre_close_price AS upDown FROM stock_rt_info WHERE cur_time=#{curTime} ORDER BY upDown DESC LIMIT 4

SELECT tmp.curTime AS time, count(*) AS count FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT( cur_time, '%Y%m%d%H%i' ) AS curTime, ( cur_price - pre_close_price ) / pre_close_price AS ud FROM stock_rt_info WHERE cur_time BETWEEN #{openTime} AND #{endTime} HAVING ud
>=0.1
<=-0.1
) AS tmp GROUP BY tmp.curTime

select case when tmp.rate > 0.07 then '>7%' when tmp.rate > 0.05 and tmp.rate <= 0.07 then '5~7%' when tmp.rate > 0.03 and tmp.rate <= 0.05 then '3~5%' when tmp.rate > 0 and tmp.rate <= 0.03 then '0~3%' when tmp.rate > -0.03 and tmp.rate <=0 then '-3~0%' when tmp.rate > -0.05 and tmp.rate <= -0.03 then '-5~-3%' when tmp.rate > -0.07 and tmp.rate <= -0.05 then '-7~-5%' ELSE '<-7%' end 'title', count(*) as count from ( select (cur_price - pre_close_price) / pre_close_price as rate from stock_rt_info where cur_time=#{curTime} ) as tmp GROUP BY title
